watch.readinessNote: The connector is a ModLoader plugin (TakaroStarRupture.dll). ModLoader refuses any game build but its own, and the plugin is compiled against the Game SDK for that build, so every new game build waits for a matching ModLoader release, a re-pin and a live retest.

mod.description: The release zip unpacked into StarRupture/Binaries/Win64: the pinned ModLoader and the plugin ModLoader/Plugins/TakaroStarRupture.dll with its config template. The plugin holds the Takaro connection itself; no sidecar
